find: const layout: MarkLayout = isNarrowViewport() ? narrowMarkLayout(slots, total) : { kind: 'full' };
why: The phone rule applied at every width: a desktop strip at four players and four or five stocks would shrink its marks or fall back to one mark and a digit with room to spare. #1021 changes only what a viewport of 480px or less draws, and the desktop control in hud.match.test.ts is the only case that renders a crowded strip WITHOUT the narrow seam, so it is the one that has to catch this.
killedBy: hud: identity-shaped stocks, the `marks` arm (issue #230) THE CONTROL for the narrow cases: the desktop strip draws every mark at full size
